svg.aria-label: Opening the case: pry open the crimped rim with a dedicated decrimping tool or insulated pliers and remove the negative cap; the tool must not touch the cap and the case at the same time. Open cells with lithium metal or LiPF6 electrolyte in the glovebox; LiPF6 forms HF on contact with water. Wear goggles and gloves.
